citi_srmu_h1_2021.name: Murders: 306 cases recorded in 2021 1st half; only one case closed so far
citi_srmu_h1_2021.publisher: Citi Newsroom (news), reporting data of the Statistics Research and Monitoring Unit (SRMU), Criminal Investigation Department, Ghana Police Service
citi_srmu_h1_2021.licence: no licence stated (news article; page footer '© 2024 All Rights Reserved Citi Newsroom'; figures are Ghana Police Service CID data quoted by the outlet)
citi_srmu_h1_2021.notes: Last-resort source under RETRY2 route 4 (police figures quoted in reputable news). Measures kept separately: cases reported to police, cases confirmed as murder after investigation, cases refused (not murder), victims by sex and by sex x age band, and case status (court / investigation / Attorney-General / closed / convicted). Some regions give only some of these. Words like 'about' or 'some' in the article are noted in the breakdown text. Regional reported counts sum to 313 = the national reported total. Article contains internal inconsistencies, kept as published (see raw/quotes.txt). Police regions are matched to geoBoundaries administrative regions by name; police 'Greater Accra' excludes Tema police region (which lies inside administrative Greater Accra), so the Greater Accra shape is larger than the police area.
